background_job_lease_ck.name: background_job_lease_ck
background_job_lease_ck.value: "app"."background_job_tasks"."status" <> 'RUNNING' or ("app"."background_job_tasks"."run_id" is not null and "app"."background_job_tasks"."lease_expires_at" is not null)

bookings_payment_snapshot_ck.name: bookings_payment_snapshot_ck
bookings_payment_snapshot_ck.value: "app"."bookings"."payment_requirement" in ('NO_UPFRONT','FULL','FIXED_DEPOSIT','PERCENT_DEPOSIT') and "app"."bookings"."required_now_minor" between 0 and "app"."bookings"."total_amount" and ("app"."bookings"."required_now_minor" = 0 or "app"."bookings"."hold_expires_at" is not null)

business_policy_values_ck.name: business_policy_values_ck
business_policy_values_ck.value:
("app"."business_booking_policies"."minimum_notice_minutes" is null or "app"."business_booking_policies"."minimum_notice_minutes" >= 0) and
    ("app"."business_booking_policies"."maximum_advance_days" is null or "app"."business_booking_policies"."maximum_advance_days" between 1 and 365) and
    ("app"."business_booking_policies"."maximum_duration_minutes" is null or "app"."business_booking_policies"."maximum_duration_minutes" between 30 and 1440) and
    "app"."business_booking_policies"."booking_buffer_minutes" between 0 and 180 and
    ("app"."business_booking_policies"."cancellation_cutoff_minutes" is null or "app"."business_booking_policies"."cancellation_cutoff_minutes" >= 0) and
    ("app"."business_booking_policies"."reschedule_cutoff_minutes" is null or "app"."business_booking_policies"."reschedule_cutoff_minutes" >= 0)

membership_plans_price_ck.name: membership_plans_price_ck
membership_plans_price_ck.value: "app"."membership_plans"."price_minor" >= 0 and "app"."membership_plans"."discount_value" >= 0 and "app"."membership_plans"."monthly_credits_minutes" >= 0 and ("app"."membership_plans"."advance_days" is null or "app"."membership_plans"."advance_days" between 1 and 365)

payment_settings_values_ck.name: payment_settings_values_ck
payment_settings_values_ck.value: ("app"."organization_payment_settings"."fixed_deposit_minor" is null or "app"."organization_payment_settings"."fixed_deposit_minor" > 0) and ("app"."organization_payment_settings"."deposit_percentage" is null or "app"."organization_payment_settings"."deposit_percentage" between 1 and 100) and "app"."organization_payment_settings"."hold_minutes" between 5 and 30

subscriptions_plan_ck.name: subscriptions_plan_ck
subscriptions_plan_ck.value: "app"."organization_subscriptions"."plan_code" in ('STARTER','PROFESSIONAL','BUSINESS','PRO') and ("app"."organization_subscriptions"."pending_plan_code" is null or "app"."organization_subscriptions"."pending_plan_code" in ('STARTER','PROFESSIONAL','BUSINESS','PRO'))

subscriptions_cycle_ck.name: subscriptions_cycle_ck
subscriptions_cycle_ck.value: "app"."organization_subscriptions"."billing_cycle" in ('MONTHLY','ANNUAL') and ("app"."organization_subscriptions"."pending_billing_cycle" is null or "app"."organization_subscriptions"."pending_billing_cycle" in ('MONTHLY','ANNUAL'))

organizations_public_policies_ck.name: organizations_public_policies_ck
organizations_public_policies_ck.value:
("app"."organizations"."cancellation_policy" is null or char_length("app"."organizations"."cancellation_policy") <= 5000)
    and ("app"."organizations"."refund_policy" is null or char_length("app"."organizations"."refund_policy") <= 5000)
    and ("app"."organizations"."venue_rules" is null or char_length("app"."organizations"."venue_rules") <= 5000)

promotions_values_ck.name: promotions_values_ck
promotions_values_ck.value: "app"."promotions"."discount_value" > 0 and "app"."promotions"."minimum_spend_minor" >= 0 and "app"."promotions"."used_count" >= 0 and ("app"."promotions"."usage_limit" is null or "app"."promotions"."usage_limit" > 0) and ("app"."promotions"."per_customer_limit" is null or "app"."promotions"."per_customer_limit" > 0) and ("app"."promotions"."maximum_discount_minor" is null or "app"."promotions"."maximum_discount_minor" > 0)
